hookups.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880251&siteId=23607 ('No Modern Amenities: There are no electric, water, sewer hook-ups, or dump stations on state forest land') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('There are no modern facilities, water, dump stations, or utility hook-ups on state forest lands'), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('There are no modern conveniences on state forest lands such as dump stations, utility hook-ups, showers, or water') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880251&siteId=23607 ('Campers are advised to bring their own water'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A single roadside site, E014 Silver Lake (Edgemere loop), on Silver Lake Road about 6.6 miles west of PA 739. Pull-in, max vehicle length 40 ft; site 75 x 100 ft with a 200-ft dirt driveway at a moderate grade.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880251&siteId=23607 ('Max Vehicle Length: 40', 'Driveway Entry: Pull-In', 'Driveway Surface: Dirt', 'Driveway Grade: Moderate', 'Driveway Length: 200', 'Site Length: 75', 'Site Width: 100', 'Silver Lake Road approximately 6.6 miles west from PA739'), read 2026-10-20

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/delaware/camping ('Motorized, roadside campsites may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival', permit and reservation required) + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880251&siteId=23607 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers, a single pull-in roadside site (E014 Silver Lake) with a 40-ft max vehicle length and a 200-ft dirt driveway, reservation required (fcfs never), open year round. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate.
